messages:
Alex: Morning team — quick triage check. Current queue: 18 tickets, 4 high-priority (two P1 billing, one model-slow, one auth). I picked up the billing P1s overnight.
Maria: Thanks. Any known platform incidents?
Alex: No platform-wide outage, but we saw a brief latency spike in us-east-1 around 02:10 UTC affecting /v1/generate for long-seq jobs — SLOs were degraded for ~6m. I opened a ticket and linked logs.
Devon: I just looked — spike maps to a bad batch size change on a Dedicated node pool (autoscaler churn). I've reverted the autoscaling knob, watching.
Sara: Estimated impact on customers?
Devon: ~3 customers saw 200-500ms extra tail latency, no errors. I've notified the three account owners.
Maria: Ok. For triage: volume trending +12% compared to yesterday, mostly embeddings and billing questions. Should we tweak macros for billing duplicate-charge flows?
Alex: Good call. I have a small macro draft. Current macro: 
```
Hi there — sorry about the double charge. Can you share the invoice id and we’ll reconcile within 3 business days?
```
Proposed tweak to speed up: add next steps and temporary credit language.
Devon: Suggestion: add steps to confirm whether charge was from Hosted vs Dedicated (hosted -> auto-refund flow). Suggested macro: 
```
Hi — sorry for the trouble. Can you paste the invoice id and confirm whether this was from your Redwood-hosted project or dedicated account? If hosted, we can issue a provisional credit while we investigate (usually within 24hrs). If dedicated, we'll escalate to finance and update you in 2 business days.
```
Sara: That looks good. I'll open a tiny PR to macros repo and tag @Maria for review.
Maria: Please also add the internal shortcut tag `#billing-duplicate` so we can filter.
Alex: For blockers: I need a code review on the new ticket-metadata change (adds origin label). @Devon, can you take a quick look? PR #2841.
Devon: On it, should be able to review in the next hour.
Sara: Also a reminder: on-call handoff at 16:00 PT. I'm taking first half, Alex takes second.
support-bot: Automated: new ticket 98321 created (billing) — linked to thread 1755555555.
Alex: Action items: 1) Sara to PR macro tweak and add `#billing-duplicate` tag. 2) Devon to review PR #2841. 3) Alex to follow up with affected customers on latency spike.
Maria: One quick note — update the macro to include the steps we do internally (refund timeframe) so support doesn't promise more than we can deliver.
Sara: Will do. PR link once created: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/72 :thumbsup:
Devon: Reviewed #2841 — left small nits, nothing blocking.
Alex: Great, thanks. If anything else pops up during the day ping here.
Sara: Closing the standup — will post PR and tag for reviews. :white_check_mark:
